title: A request waiting on a silent upstream holds the only inflight slot; a concurrent request gets 503 overloaded
notes: Load is POST /mcp, a JSON-RPC tools/call of ultrathink_uplift, which is the route that waits on the upstream. The router holds one inflight slot per non-probe request for its whole dispatch (routes/router.ts, inflight.enter around line 1159), and the uplift handler awaits planner.start, which awaits the plan backend. So a call waiting on the silent upstream holds the slot, and a second concurrent request is refused with 503 overloaded and Retry-After 1, counted by ultrathink_overload_total. The default model timeout is 0 (off, config.ts DEFAULT_MODEL_TIMEOUT_MS), so a silent upstream would hold the slot until the planner's whole-plan timer fires; config.timeoutMs 1000 bounds it through the plan backend's own kill of the silent child (chaos/faults.ts createFaultyClaude). The 503 on the load path is proven by the overload counter: a status hypothesis reads one fixed path, not the load responses. /readyz is never shed (routes/router.ts UNGATED). The harness must enable server planning and present the connector key; this template holds no credential.
